host_processor_caches: L1d 9 MiB, L1i 9 MiB, L2 144 MiB, L3 228 MiB (2 instances) per node
host_processor_interconnect: 2 Grace sockets per node; CPU-to-CPU NUMA distance 40 (numactl -H); each Grace attaches to its 2 GB300 GPUs over NVLink-C2C
host_memory_capacity: 1.0 TB per node (LPDDR5X; MemTotal of the two CPU NUMA nodes = 956.8 GiB on each node)
host_storage_capacity: 4x 3.84 TB NVMe (Solidigm SB5PHU7X038T) RAID0 14 TB + 1x 1.92 TB NVMe (Samsung MZ1L21T9HCLS) boot
host_networking: NVIDIA ConnectX-8 Ethernet/RoCE (not used for training collectives)
host_networking_topology: The accelerators communicate over NVLink (both nodes in one GB300 NVL72 NVLink domain), not over the host network; the Ethernet/RoCE fabric carries management and storage traffic
accelerator_on-chip_memories: L2 cache 135528448 bytes (129.25 MiB) per GPU, 152 SMs
accelerator_interconnect: NVLink 5 (18 links x 53.125 GB/s per direction per GPU) + NVLink Switch
accelerator_interconnect_topology: Multi-node NVLink: both trays in one GB300 NVL72 NVLink/IMEX domain
hw_notes: Nodes CBR01-DH01-SVR-CN010429 and CBR01-DH01-SVR-CN010434, 2 x NVIDIA Grace (Arm Neoverse-V2, 72 cores each) and 4 x NVIDIA GB300 per node, both nodes in one GB300 NVL72 NVLink / IMEX domain.
host_network_card_count: 5 per node: 4 x NVIDIA ConnectX-8 (MT4131; the RoCE rails roce_r0-r3, 400 Gb/s each) + 1 x NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU (MT41692; mlx5_bond_0, 400 Gb/s)
sw_notes: Container: NVIDIA's build of benchmarks/gpt_oss_20b/implementations/nemo_g1_1012/Dockerfile, NVIDIA's MLPerf Training v6.1 (20261012) gpt_oss_20b recipe with code and Dockerfile unchanged, on nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3. Not rebuilt; the Dockerfile is byte-identical to the 20261006 one, and the image records the same public commits of Transformer Engine, Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-Core, DeepEP, mlperf-logging and mlperf-common (implementations/firmus_gb300_ngpu8_gptoss_g1_1012/README.md). Config: config_GB300_2x4x3xtp1pp1cp1ep1_mxfp8.sh, NVIDIA's GB300 config from the same release, unchanged.
